advice:
This course consists of two parts. One is Pre-guidance for final preparation of Teaching Practice, and the other is Post-guidance for reflection on Teaching Practice.
1. Pre-guidance
It includes lectures by experienced teachers in secondary school. Students will make a concrete image of you during Teaching Practice, survey the training school and teachers’ job in school, and make a lesson plan.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Investigate the actual circumstances of training school and make a lesson plan according to them.
(2) Reflect on the learning activities at the university, set objectives with solid attitude toward teaching practice.
(3) Reflect on teaching practice and evaluate the aptitude as a teacher strictly.
(4) Reflect on teaching practice, evaluate the achievement of the objectives, and clarify the deal teacher image to be aimed and future measures to aim for it.

              The objectives of Teacher Practice are working at a school experientially,  determining own aptitude as a teacher, and clarifying the ideal teacher . To achieve the objectives, It is needed to understand teacher job and responsibilities and define the goals of teaching practice as preparation. After teaching practice, it is important to reflect on teaching practice and check the achievement status of the goals. This course is significant for considering the own aptitude as a teacher.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course consists of two parts. One is Pre-guidance for final preparation of Teaching Practice, and the other is Post-guidance for reflection on Teaching Practice.
1. Pre-guidance
It includes lectures by experienced teachers in secondary school. Students will make a concrete image of you during Teaching Practice, survey the training school and teachers’ job in school, and make a lesson plan.
2. Post-guidance
It includes check the achievement status of the goals, and discussion about each experience during Teaching Practice.
